fields.description: A WebDAV dead property (RFC 4918 §4.4) — client-stored metadata PROPPATCHed onto an entity. One row per (entity, namespace, name); rows follow the entity through MOVE, are cloned by COPY and wiped when it is deleted. All protocol access goes through the WebDAV engine, not this form.
fields.label: Property

fields.description: The Drive Node this property is attached to.
fields.label: Entity

fields.description: Namespace URI qualifying the property name (e.g. urn:schemas-microsoft-com:); empty for the null namespace.
fields.label: Namespace

fields.description: The property's local name within the namespace.
fields.label: Property Name

fields.description: The full serialized property element, namespace declarations included, so client XML round-trips byte-faithfully (prefixes may be rewritten; namespace URIs are preserved). Capped at 64 KB by the engine.
fields.label: Value XML
